hook.en: A coaching centre tests six students before and after a crash course. With so few values the normal test is not reliable. Student's t-test is built for small samples drawn from normal populations.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ತರಬೇತಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಆರು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ತರಬೇತಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಷ್ಟು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ Z ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಸೂಕ್ತವಲ್ಲ. ಸ್ಟೂಡೆಂಟ್‌ನ t-ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮಾದರಿಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.

objectives.en: Apply the t-test for a single mean
Apply the t-test for two independent means (pooled variance)

narration.en: A coaching centre tests six students before and after a crash course. With so few values the normal test is not reliable. Student's t-test is built for small samples drawn from normal populations.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ತರಬೇತಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಆರು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ತರಬೇತಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಷ್ಟು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ Z ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಸೂಕ್ತವಲ್ಲ. ಸ್ಟೂಡೆಂಟ್‌ನ t-ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮಾದರಿಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.

body.en: For a small sample ($n \le 30$) from a normal population with unknown $\sigma$, to test $H_0: \mu = \mu_0$ use $t = \dfrac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{s/\sqrt{n}}$ with $n - 1$ d.f., where $s^2 = \dfrac{\sum (x - \bar{x})^2}{n - 1}$. Compare $|t|$ with the table value $t_{\alpha}(n-1)$.
body.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಮಾದರಿಗೆ t = (x̄ − μ₀)/(s/√n), d.f. n − 1, ಇಲ್ಲಿ s² = Σ(x − x̄)²/(n − 1). |t| ಅನ್ನು ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಬೆಲೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.

points.en: Population normal, σ unknown, n small

narration.en: For a small sample (n ≤ 30) from a normal population with unknown sigma, to test H_0: mu = mu_0 use t = dfracx-bar - mu_0s/rootn with n - 1 d.f., where s^2 = dfracsum (x - x-bar)^2n - 1. Compare |t| with the table value t_alpha(n-1).
narration.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಮಾದರಿಗೆ t = (x̄ − μ₀)/(s/√n), d.f. n − 1, ಇಲ್ಲಿ s² = Σ(x − x̄)²/(n − 1). |t| ಅನ್ನು ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಬೆಲೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.

title.en: A paired t-test on the board

narration.en: The teacher tabulates before-and-after marks, finds the differences and their mean and s.d., and computes t.

say.en: Marks of six students before and after a course. Write the table and the differences d.
The mean difference is 17 over 6, about 2.83.
The s.d. of the differences, with divisor n minus 1, is about 1.17.
t is d bar over s d by root n: about 5.94 with 5 degrees of freedom.
The one-tailed 5 percent value for 5 d.f. is 2.015. 5.94 is far bigger, so the course has raised the marks.

explanation.en: One sample against a stated value: t for a single mean (n − 1 d.f.). Two separate groups: t for the difference of means with pooled S (n₁ + n₂ − 2 d.f.). The same units measured twice: paired t on the differences (pairs − 1 d.f.).

body.en: Two independent samples (equal population variances): $t = \dfrac{\bar{x}_1 - \bar{x}_2}{S\sqrt{1/n_1 + 1/n_2}}$ with $n_1 + n_2 - 2$ d.f., where $S^2 = \dfrac{\sum(x_1 - \bar{x}_1)^2 + \sum(x_2 - \bar{x}_2)^2}{n_1 + n_2 - 2}$. Paired observations (same units measured twice): with $d = x - y$, $t = \dfrac{\bar{d}}{s_d/\sqrt{n}}$ with $n - 1$ d.f.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಮಾದರಿಗಳು: t = (x̄₁ − x̄₂)/(S√(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)), d.f. n₁ + n₂ − 2; S² ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಪ್ರಸರಣ. ಜೋಡಿ ಮಾದರಿ: d = x − y, t = d̄/(s_d/√n), d.f. n − 1.

points.en: Pooled S² for two independent samples
Paired: work with the differences d

narration.en: Two independent samples (equal population variances): t = dfracx-bar_1 - x-bar_2Sroot1/n_1 + 1/n_2 with n_1 + n_2 - 2 d.f., where S^2 = dfracsum(x_1 - x-bar_1)^2 + sum(x_2 - x-bar_2)^2n_1 + n_2 - 2. Paired observations (same units measured twice): with d = x - y, t = dfracds_d/rootn with n - 1 d.f.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಮಾದರಿಗಳು: t = (x̄₁ − x̄₂)/(S√(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)), d.f. n₁ + n₂ − 2; S² ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಪ್ರಸರಣ. ಜೋಡಿ ಮಾದರಿ: d = x − y, t = d̄/(s_d/√n), d.f. n − 1.

caption.en: Paired t-test: set the mean difference, its s.d. and the number of pairs. The red line marks t on the t curve with n − 1 d.f.

narration.en: Move the mean difference and the number of pairs. More pairs give more degrees of freedom and a larger t for the same mean difference.

tryThis.en: Halve s_d. What happens to t?
With d̄ = 1 and s_d = 2, how many pairs make t exceed 2?
